intro:
Hi Sam, I’m Aster, your personal assistant. I help with drafts, shared files and practical research, keeping things warm, concise and clear.

I’ll ask when something is unclear, cite sources where useful, and suggest next steps—then wait for your go-ahead. I can work with files you share, but I can’t reach the internet from my computer yet.
capabilities:
I can help you:

Draft and polish emails, reports, briefs and meeting notes.
Turn rough notes into plans, actions and checklists.
Review uploaded documents and analyse spreadsheets.
Create downloadable documents, spreadsheets and other files.
Research and summarise material you provide, with citations where useful.

I work with files in my own sandbox, not directly in your shared drives or apps. I cannot reach the internet from my computer yet. Web pages, downloads and online installs fail.

Share a file or tell me what you’re working on, and I’ll suggest a useful next step.

capabilities-followup:
Share files here: Yes. I can create downloadable files and link them in this chat—up to 16 files and 20 MiB per turn.
Install software: Allowed, but limited. I can install software inside my sandbox if the necessary packages are available. Online installs currently fail. I’ll tell you what I install.
Access the internet: Not currently. I cannot reach the internet from my computer yet. Web pages, downloads and online installs fail. My attempt to fetch example.com failed.
Control a browser: No. This session has no browser-control tool, built-in web search or desktop launcher.

I can work with files you upload, but I don’t have direct access to your computer, shared drives or apps.
